## About
Ricciardi Auto Body is a family-owned and operated shop at 4045 Garrett Road in Drexel Hill. We know how frustrating an auto accident can be, so we work to keep the hassle as small as possible and make getting your car repaired easy.
Our technicians are fully trained, and the shop is ASE certified, AAA approved, and licensed, bonded and insured. One reviewer put it simply: family owned and in business for decades.
Our promise is to treat you and your vehicle with respect. We hold a 4.4 rating from 40 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto Body Repair: If your vehicle got damaged in a collision or accident, our experienced technicians will fix your auto body and collision problems.
- Frame Straightening: From auto body reconstruction repairs to frame straightening, we handle the structural work too.
- Color matching: Paint matched to your car, so the repair blends in with the rest of the body.
- Collision Repair: Repairs after an accident, from the first estimate to handing you back your keys.
- Insurance claims: We accept any insurance claims and work with your insurance company's appraisal.
- Towing: If your car can't be driven, towing is available around the clock.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance?
A: Yes. We accept any insurance claims.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free.

Q: Can you tow my car to the shop?
A: Yes. Towing is available 24 hours a day.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We're on Garrett Road in Drexel Hill and serve Delaware and Chester Counties.

Q: When was the shop founded?
A: The shop was founded in 1981, and we serve the community of Drexel Hill with quality auto body and collision repair.
